title: Basilica and Convent of San Francisco, Lima
geometryBasis: The named heritage ensemble pins the location. Standing basilica, convent and Miracle Chapel footprints and the open main courtyard use separately mapped building rings.
sectionBasis: Three published 1868 albumen prints show the front towers and portal, side silhouette with the nave dome, and two tiers of arcades at the principal cloister. Numerical map measurements anchor the horizontal plan.
limitations: Fine carvings and post-earthquake details are simplified. Towers, lanterns and sanctuary roof heights are estimated from the archival photographs and mapped footprint.
The separately mapped Iglesia de Nuestra Señora de la Soledad, catacombs, furnishings and plaza are outside the scope. The terrain survey does not resolve smaller level changes.
